segments: the border polygon (tools/argonia_world/terrain/edges.py border_polygon) cut every 4 cells: 126 per side, 504 in all; plus the two exit gates (edges.gates)
per_segment: teleport 30 m inside the border, facing out
push outward with short forward inputs for 10 s (SkyLink input, no mode or switch)
read the player position each second
pass: the position never crosses the border polygon; at a gate the closed-road message shows
still: one at the farthest point reached
fails_if: a crossing; a fall through the ground; the game crashes
